description: Step 5 Preview is StepFun's 600B sparse MoE frontier model for production-scale agents, activating 27B parameters per token. It is built for software engineering, long-horizon tool use, research, professional knowledge work, and finance, with native text, image, and video understanding and a 1M-token context window. ⚠️ Note: This model routes through StepFun, so privacy and logging guarantees may be limited.
name: Step 5 Preview
